sentences.en: This isn't normally how we do things, three guests in the same room, but we think this is a big enough and important enough conversation to merit doing it this way.
sentences.zh: 我们通常不会这样做，让三位嘉宾在同一个房间里，但我们认为这次对话足够重大、足够重要，值得以这种方式进行。

sentences.en: And the reason we felt this way is because all three of you have been engaged in a months-long line of reporting about what a second Donald Trump presidential term would look like,
sentences.zh: 我们之所以有这种感觉，是因为你们三位都已经进行了长达数月的报道，内容是关于唐纳德·特朗普的第二个总统任期会是什么样子，

sentences.en: what Trump 2.0 would seek to achieve, how different it would be from the first term, and how much more it might test the norms of our government
sentences.zh: 特朗普2.0版本会寻求实现什么目标，它与第一个任期会有多大不同，以及它可能会在多大程度上考验我们政府的规范，

sentences.en: and perhaps even the values of our democracy.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能考验我们民主的价值观。

sentences.en: So just to begin, why in your own minds did you undertake this project and what were your biggest questions heading into it?
sentences.zh: 那么，首先，你们自己为什么要进行这个项目？在开始之前，你们最大的疑问是什么？

sentences.en: Jonathan?
sentences.zh: 乔纳森？

sentences.en: It's an obvious reporting project when you have somebody who's already served in government.
sentences.zh: 当你面对一个已经在政府任职过的人时，这是一个显而易见的报道项目。

sentences.en: You have this body of accomplishments, work, intentions, that he's half-completed, fully completed in some cases in the first term, and now he's running for office again.
sentences.zh: 他有一系列成就、工作和意图，有些在第一个任期内完成了一半，有些则完全完成了，现在他又在竞选公职。

sentences.en: But what made it different and why we were so intensely interested in this very early is that Donald Trump's last year of his first term
sentences.zh: 但让它与众不同、让我们如此早地产生浓厚兴趣的原因是，唐纳德·特朗普第一个任期的最后一年，

sentences.en: was very different from the first three years, and it was really a foreshadowing of what a second term would look like.
sentences.zh: 与前三年非常不同，这实际上预示了第二个任期会是什么样子。

sentences.en: And where I sort of begin in my mental map of this is the first impeachment of Donald Trump in early 2020.
sentences.zh: 在我脑海中，我从2020年初唐纳德·特朗普的第一次弹劾开始梳理。

sentences.en: We know from our reporting that he was sitting in the dining room adjoining the Oval Office watching these proceedings on television, and he's watching this assortment of people
sentences.zh: 我们从报道中得知，他当时坐在椭圆形办公室隔壁的餐厅里，在电视上观看这些程序，他看着这群人，

sentences.en: who sort of embodied in his mind the deep state testifying against him, and he's saying, who the F is this person?
sentences.zh: 在他看来，这些人体现了“深层政府”对他作证，他说，这人是谁啊？

sentences.en: Who's this person?
sentences.zh: 这人是谁？

sentences.en: Who are these snakes?
sentences.zh: 这些蛇蝎是谁？

sentences.en: They're out to get me.
sentences.zh: 他们想对付我。

sentences.en: And there were people in his government.
sentences.zh: 而这些人就在他的政府里。

sentences.en: And after that impeachment, when he was acquitted, this is a guy who wanted to take names and get rid of them.
sentences.zh: 在那次弹劾之后，当他被判无罪时，他是一个想要记下名字并除掉他们的人。

sentences.en: This was a guy motivated by vengeance.
sentences.zh: 这是一个被复仇心理驱动的人。

sentences.en: So he brings back in his body man, former body man, Johnny McEntee, who's this young guy who had no government experience, and he basically says, come in.
sentences.zh: 所以他带回了他的贴身随从，前贴身随从约翰尼·麦肯蒂，这是一个没有政府经验的年轻人，他基本上说，进来吧。

sentences.en: I want you in charge of presidential personnel, and I want you to get rid of all the snakes, get rid of all the disloyal people.
sentences.zh: 我要你负责总统人事，我要你除掉所有的蛇蝎，除掉所有不忠诚的人。

sentences.en: And that sort of sets the train for this last 10, 11 months of government.
sentences.zh: 这为政府最后10到11个月的运作定下了基调。

sentences.en: And one addendum to that, Michael, a lot of what they wanted to accomplish that year, they couldn't because of COVID.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点还有一个补充，迈克尔，他们那一年想实现的目标中，有很多因为新冠疫情而无法实现。

sentences.en: COVID changed a lot of what they were looking at doing.
sentences.zh: 新冠疫情改变了他们很多计划。

sentences.en: Changed their focus.
sentences.zh: 改变了他们的重点。

sentences.en: Changed their focus.
sentences.zh: 改变了他们的重点。

sentences.en: Now, they resumed ultimately trying to focus on purging the government of people who they believed were opposed to Trump,
sentences.zh: 现在，他们最终恢复了试图清除政府中那些他们认为反对特朗普的人的计划，

sentences.en: but they were thrown from where they were initially heading shortly after the impeachment ended because of COVID.
sentences.zh: 但由于新冠疫情，他们在弹劾结束后不久就偏离了最初的方向。

sentences.en: And obviously, that last year of the presidency and this new approach, all of this came to a head after the election and in the lead up to January 6th,
sentences.zh: 显然，总统任期的最后一年和这种新方法，所有这些都在选举后和1月6日之前达到了顶峰，

sentences.en: where Donald Trump, desperate to overturn the election, had to search outside the White House for lawyers who would tell him what he wanted to hear,
sentences.zh: 当时唐纳德·特朗普为了推翻选举结果，不得不去白宫外寻找那些会告诉他他想听的话的律师，

sentences.en: that Mike Pence, your vice president, can unilaterally reject the results of the election.
sentences.zh: 比如迈克·彭斯，你的副总统，可以单方面拒绝选举结果。

sentences.en: And for people who would tell him that you can order your Department of Homeland Security to go around the country seizing voting machines,
sentences.zh: 以及那些会告诉他，你可以命令国土安全部去全国各地扣押投票机的人，

sentences.en: those were the ideas that he was seeking out.
sentences.zh: 那些就是他正在寻找的想法。

sentences.en: But he was stymied.
sentences.zh: 但他受阻了。

sentences.en: He was stymied because they hadn't accomplished what they set out to accomplish in terms of ridding the government of people who would be impediments.
sentences.zh: 他受阻是因为他们还没有实现在清除政府中那些会成为阻碍的人方面的目标。

sentences.en: Those impediments were still there at the end.
sentences.zh: 那些阻碍在最后时刻依然存在。

sentences.en: And they proved very decisive, including the ultimate impediment, which was his vice president.
sentences.zh: 事实证明他们非常关键，包括最终的阻碍，也就是他的副总统。

sentences.en: And so what we found through our reporting is that he wants to make certain that in a second term,
sentences.zh: 所以我们通过报道发现，他想确保在第二个任期内，

sentences.en: those people who were pushing back, particularly in that last period, are not there.
sentences.zh: 那些曾经进行抵制的人，特别是在最后那段时间里的人，不会再出现。

sentences.en: And that, in fact, the people who are there are people who are going to be bringing him the means of achieving what he wants to achieve.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在那里的将是那些能够为他提供实现他想要目标手段的人。

sentences.en: Well, what does he want to achieve?
sentences.zh: 那么，他想实现什么？

sentences.en: What do all of your combined reporting efforts reveal, top line, about what Donald Trump would seek in a second term?
sentences.zh: 你们所有人的综合报道工作揭示了什么？关于唐纳德·特朗普在第二个任期内会寻求什么，核心是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the first thing we all agreed on in this project was we didn't want this to be some fan fiction, sitting around, you know, smoking a pipe,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们在这个项目上达成一致的第一件事是，我们不想让这成为某种同人小说，大家坐在一起，抽着烟，

sentences.en: trying to imagine what a second term of Trump would look like.
sentences.zh: 试图想象特朗普的第二个任期会是什么样子。

sentences.en: We want it to be rooted in real reporting.
sentences.zh: 我们希望它植根于真实的报道。

sentences.en: And also, where the sweet spot of this series was is we had reporting on what Trump himself
sentences.zh: 而且，这个系列报道的精髓在于，我们掌握了特朗普本人在核心圈子里私下所说的话，

sentences.en: has been saying privately in his inner circle, and the intersection of that with this very well-funded and quite vast network of outside groups that are formulating policy.
sentences.zh: 以及这些话与那些资金雄厚、规模庞大的制定政策的外部团体之间的交集。

sentences.en: And so we focused very intently on things that Donald Trump himself cares about.
sentences.zh: 所以我们非常专注于唐纳德·特朗普本人关心的事情。

sentences.en: And at the heart of that is power, centralizing power, clearing away guardrails.
sentences.zh: 而其核心是权力，集中权力，清除护栏。

sentences.en: And that is why Charlie became such an essential partner for Maggie and I, because, you know,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么查理成为了玛吉和我不可或缺的合作伙伴，因为，你知道，

sentences.en: Maggie and I have the background with Trump.
sentences.zh: 玛吉和我拥有关于特朗普的背景。

sentences.en: We have the sourcing in his world and the conservative movement, the outside groups.
sentences.zh: 我们在他的世界和保守派运动、外部团体中拥有消息来源。

sentences.en: But what we don't have is what Charlie has, which is expertise in executive power and understanding the legal aspects of all of this.
sentences.zh: 但我们没有查理所拥有的东西，那就是行政权方面的专业知识，以及对所有这些法律层面的理解。

sentences.en: Well, thank you for that, Jonathan.
sentences.zh: 好吧，谢谢你，乔纳森。

sentences.en: I could listen to you all day.
sentences.zh: 我可以听你说一整天。

sentences.en: The, uh, no, I think the top line of all of this is Trump is someone who's interested in his own personal
sentences.zh: 不，我认为所有这些的核心是，特朗普是一个对自己的个人权力感兴趣的人，

sentences.en: power in removing any interior barriers, guardrails, or constraints on that power.
sentences.zh: 他致力于消除对这种权力的任何内部障碍、护栏或约束。

sentences.en: He's far more interested in power as an into itself than in the details of policy.
sentences.zh: 他对比政策细节更感兴趣的是权力本身。

sentences.en: And yet he's surrounded by people who have their own policy agendas that align with him and are telling him, we will increase your power so that you can do these things.
sentences.zh: 然而，他身边的人有他们自己的政策议程，这些议程与他一致，并告诉他：我们会增加你的权力，这样你就可以做这些事情。

sentences.en: And therefore it is a pulling together towards a presidency that would be unlike anything we have seen before.
sentences.zh: 因此，这正汇聚成一个我们将前所未见的总统任期。

sentences.en: So I just want to be very clear about this because it's so central to the work you're all doing to understand what another Trump presidency might be like.
sentences.zh: 所以我只想把这一点说清楚，因为这对于你们所有人正在做的工作至关重要，以了解另一个特朗普总统任期可能会是什么样子。

sentences.en: He, you have found, wants more power for its own sake mostly.
sentences.zh: 你们发现，他主要是为了权力本身而想要更多的权力。

sentences.en: And at the same time, there are people around him who hope to achieve certain policy goals.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他身边的人希望实现某些政策目标。

sentences.en: And they've identified that the best way to do that is for Trump to accumulate the power that he wants.
sentences.zh: 他们已经认定，实现这一目标的最好方法就是让特朗普积累他想要的权力。

sentences.en: So together, they've collectively determined that the way to accomplish all of this is to remove the encumbrances and the obstacles that stood in Trump's way the first time and
sentences.zh: 所以他们共同决定，实现这一切的方法就是消除第一次阻碍特朗普的那些负担和障碍，

sentences.en: make sure that they are not present in a second term.
sentences.zh: 并确保它们在第二个任期内不会出现。

sentences.en: So let's talk about the details of how Trump and those around him might achieve all of this logistically.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们谈谈特朗普及其身边的人如何在后勤上实现这一切的细节。

sentences.en: Where do you all think we should start?
sentences.zh: 你们认为我们应该从哪里开始？

sentences.en: What he's going to look for is people who are much more ideologically aligned with him.
sentences.zh: 他将寻找的是在意识形态上与他更加一致的人。

sentences.en: And he's focused on a cabinet full of people who are going to find ways to enact the policies that he wants.
sentences.zh: 他专注于一个充满能够找到方法来制定他想要的政策的人的内阁。

sentences.en: And what would characterize the people he would be choosing in a term two cabinet?
sentences.zh: 那么，他在第二个任期内选择的内阁成员会有什么特征？

sentences.en: It is going to be people who he thinks are going to enact whatever his agenda in that moment is, who won't stymie him on foreign policy, who won't go out and oppose him on
sentences.zh: 这些人将是他认为会执行他当时任何议程的人，他们不会在外交政策上阻碍他，不会出去反对他，

sentences.en: his views on NATO, for instance.
sentences.zh: 例如，反对他对北约的看法。

sentences.en: Trump wants people who are going to help him get to a yes, not a no.
sentences.zh: 特朗普想要的是那些能帮他达成“是”而不是“否”的人。

sentences.en: And to put a finer point on it, his biggest regret from his first term is personnel.
sentences.zh: 更确切地说，他第一个任期最大的遗憾是人事问题。

sentences.en: It's the people he hired.
sentences.zh: 是他雇佣的人。

sentences.en: You ask him what his biggest regret is, he'll just list names.
sentences.zh: 你问他最大的遗憾是什么，他只会列出一串名字。

sentences.en: Jeff Sessions, the first attorney general, Bill Barr, the second attorney general, John
sentences.zh: 杰夫·塞申斯，第一任司法部长；比尔·巴尔，第二任司法部长；约翰·博尔顿，

sentences.en: Bolton, all the generals that he appointed, Mark Milley, the chairman of the Joint Chiefs.
sentences.zh: 所有他任命的将军，马克·米利，参谋长联席会议主席。

sentences.en: Basically, the list of people that you see going out and saying that he's unfit to serve,
sentences.zh: 基本上，你看到的那些出去说他不适合担任公职的人名单，

sentences.en: that's the group of people that really surrounded him for the first two, three years of the administration.
sentences.zh: 就是那群在政府执政的前两三年里真正围绕在他身边的人。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And many of them saw their job as protecting the country and the world from Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人认为自己的工作是保护国家和世界免受唐纳德·特朗普的影响。

sentences.en: In that last year, Trump cleared out several of these people that he regarded as disloyal
sentences.zh: 在最后一年，特朗普清理了几个他认为不忠诚或阻挠的人，

sentences.en: or obstructionist and started to appoint people that he viewed as loyal, as people who were willing to implement his agenda.
sentences.zh: 并开始任命他认为忠诚的人，即那些愿意执行他议程的人。

sentences.en: But in his mind, he hadn't gone nearly far enough.
sentences.zh: 但在他看来，他做得还远远不够。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So let's assume Trump is able to get the cabinet that he wants and make the appointments that he wants.
sentences.zh: 那么，假设特朗普能够得到他想要的内阁并做出他想要的任命。

sentences.en: What would Trump likely turn to next?
sentences.zh: 特朗普接下来可能会转向什么？

sentences.zh: 我认为在某种程度上，强人政治的想法具有巨大的吸引力。

sentences.en: It's not just like Democrats have bad policies, it's they're trying to destroy the country and they need to be defeated.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是说民主党的政策很糟糕，而是说他们试图摧毁这个国家，必须被击败。

sentences.en: You hear this sort of trope from old line establishment Republicans, I like Trump's policy, but I don't like his personality.
sentences.zh: 你会听到老派建制派共和党人说这种陈词滥调：我喜欢特朗普的政策，但我不喜欢他的个性。

sentences.en: There's this new kind of theory on the new right, which is like, no, Trump's personality is actually essential.
sentences.zh: 新右派有一种新理论，认为不，特朗普的个性实际上至关重要。

sentences.en: He's the guy we need for this battle we're in.
sentences.zh: 他是我们这场战斗所需要的人。

sentences.en: And actually, we shouldn't be trying to limit the federal government and reduce its size, because what suckers we are if we do that?
sentences.zh: 实际上，我们不应该试图限制联邦政府并缩小其规模，因为如果我们那样做，我们就是傻瓜，不是吗？

sentences.en: No, we need to seize power and use the instruments of power to defeat our adversaries.
sentences.zh: 不，我们需要夺取权力，并利用权力的工具来击败我们的对手。

sentences.en: It actually fits quite neatly with what we've been talking about today, because what is strong,
sentences.zh: 这实际上与我们今天讨论的内容非常吻合，因为什么是强大，

sentences.en: but, you know, blowing through any obstacle or barrier or impediment to you doing what you want to do?
sentences.zh: 不就是冲破任何阻碍你做想做之事的障碍、屏障或阻碍吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, or person.
sentences.zh: 是的，或者是人。

sentences.en: That is the embodiment of strength.
sentences.zh: 那才是力量的化身。

sentences.en: Well, to all three of you, Maggie, Charlie, Jonathan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好吧，非常感谢你们三位，玛吉、查理、乔纳森。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thanks, mate.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，伙计。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, more than 200 protesters were arrested at college campuses across the country
sentences.zh: 周末，全国各地的大学校园里有200多名抗议者被捕，

sentences.en: as administrators and police sought to rein in pro-Palestinian demonstrations and encampments.
sentences.zh: 当时行政人员和警察试图控制亲巴勒斯坦的示威活动和营地。

sentences.en: The arrests occurred at Northeastern University, Arizona State University, Indiana University, and Washington University in St. Louis.
sentences.zh: 逮捕行动发生在东北大学、亚利桑那州立大学、印第安纳大学和圣路易斯的华盛顿大学。

sentences.en: In each case, officials said that the protesters had violated campus rules, defied orders to disperse, or become dangerously anti-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 在每起案件中，官员都表示抗议者违反了校园规定，无视解散命令，或变得具有危险的反犹太主义倾向。

sentences.en: Overall, police have arrested more than 800 protesters on college campuses since April 18th
sentences.zh: 总体而言，自4月18日以来，警方已在大学校园逮捕了800多名抗议者，

sentences.en: when Columbia University asked police to remove a pro-Palestinian encampment at the center of campus.
sentences.zh: 当时哥伦比亚大学要求警方拆除校园中心的一个亲巴勒斯坦营地。

sentences.en: Student protesters have since rebuilt that encampment, and Columbia has said it will not ask police to clear it.
sentences.zh: 学生抗议者此后重建了那个营地，哥伦比亚大学表示不会要求警方清理它。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。
